subject.title: fix(ci): ignore profiling-only resource gate failures

question: Should OpenClaw's release workflow accept this profiled-resource-only Kova DO_NOT_SHIP tolerance once the draft is ready and exact-head proof is green?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but the behavior deliberately changes a release-gate fail-open boundary and needs maintainer ownership rather than automatic cleanup or repair.

options.title: Accept After Exact-Head Proof
options.body: Keep the current narrow classifier and merge after the draft is ready and current-head gates/proof cover the real retry report plus negative cases.

options.title: Tighten Before Merge
options.body: Ask for additional classifier constraints or real-report fixtures if maintainers want less tolerance around profiled Kova resource failures.

options.title: Reject The Tolerance
options.body: Keep all Kova DO_NOT_SHIP verdicts blocking and handle profiler overhead by changing Kova thresholds or profile policy instead.

recommendation.title: Accept After Exact-Head Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the current narrow classifier and merge after the draft is ready and current-head gates/proof cover the real retry report plus negative cases.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent owns the PR and the pinned Kova behavior the adapter relies on.
